items.t: Remember AMC? The Meme Stock Is Up 106% This Year
items.sum: AMC just posted a record quarter and its CEO declared the company recovered, yet the people who own the stock may not feel it. One quiet number on the balance sheet explains why the rally and the recovery are not the same story.

items.t: AMC shares gain as weekend attendance tops 4.1 million amid Hunger Games opening
items.sum: Investing.com -- Shares of AMC Entertainment Holdings Inc (NYSE:AMC) rose 7.3% in Monday trading after the theater operator reported welcoming more than 4.1 million moviegoers across its domestic and international venues over the weekend.
